clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, Beldin Steelgrill keeps dwarven war machines running. He is its master technician, renowned in Khaz Modan for repairing siege engines and armored wagons. His work depends on a steady supply of specialized tools.

Just down the road from Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot is where dwarven steam tanks and siege engines are tested and serviced. Beldin Steelgrill runs the work as its chief technician, known across Khaz Modan for repairing and tuning armored war wagons. The work is hard on heavy wrenches, cutters, and precision instruments. Beldin needs them constantly, keeping local ironworkers busy supplying his bench.
